content.title: How to Watch the Braves | Atlanta Braves
content.text: The Atlanta Braves announce launch of exclusive television network: BravesVision.Introducing BravesVision, a multimedia platform owned and operated by the Atlanta Braves, the official local television home of the Braves for the 2026 baseball season. BravesVision ushers in a new era of broadcasting, where the Braves organization oversees the production, sales, marketing, and distribution of its telecasts.BravesVision will produce more than 140 games, as well as extensive pregame and postgame programming, throughout the 2026 regular season and give fans across the organization’s six state territory multiple options to watch Braves games without blackouts.A trio of former Braves Peter Moylan, Nick Green, and Charlie Culberson will host the new BravesVision pregame show, “Braves On Deck,” and postgame show, “Braves Postgame,” offering news, analysis, and a look at the unparalleled gameday experience at Truist Park and The Battery Atlanta.Watch the Braves on TVVideo Service Provider: BravesVision is available on cable, satellite, and streaming services, including: Xfinity (channel 1254) DIRECTV (channel 645) Spectrum Fubo U-Verse (channel 1730) and multiple providers throughout Braves Country Over the Air: For the second year in a row, the Atlanta Braves are partnering with Gray Media to broadcast select games for free on local over-the-air (OTA) TV stations across Atlanta and the Southeast. These broadcasts will show the same game coverage as BravesVision and can be watched with a standard TV antenna. Visit bravesongray.combravesongray.com to find your local Gray station and learn how to watch. The following games will be available via Gray Media stations:Friday, March 27 vs. Royals (Opening Day)Tuesday, March 31 vs. AthleticsTuesday, April 7 @ AngelsTuesday, April 14 vs. MarlinsTuesday, April 21 @ NationalsTuesday, May 5 @ MarinersSunday, May 10 @ DodgersTuesday, May 12 vs. CubsFriday, May 15 vs. Red SoxSaturday, May 16 vs. Red SoxSunday, May 17 vs. Red SoxMonday, May 18 vs. MarlinsTuesday, June 2 vs. Blue JaysTuesday, June 9 @ White SoxSunday, June 14 vs. MetsTuesday, June 16 vs. GiantsTuesday, June 23 @ PadresTuesday, June 30 vs. CardinalsTuesday, July 7 @ PiratesTuesday, July 21 vs. PadresTuesday, July 28 @ MetsTuesday, August 11 vs. MetsTuesday, August 25 vs. DodgersTuesday, September 8 vs. RaysTuesday, September 15 @ CubsStream the BravesStream Atlanta Braves games with Braves.TV!BravesVision TV broadcasts of Atlanta Braves games will be available on Braves.TV, a new streaming platform from Major League Baseball. With a subscription, all regular season non-national exclusive Braves games will be available to fans everywhere within the Braves television market with NO BLACKOUTS! Fans will have the additional option to purchase an out-of-market package to view every MLB team.A season subscription to Braves.TV, featuring live and on-demand streaming on over 140 regular season Braves games with no local blackouts, is available for $99.99. A monthly subscription is available for $19.99. Listen to the BravesCatch every Braves baseball game on the radio on The Fan, 680 and 93.7FM (WCNN). The Braves Radio Network, consisting of more than 170 radio stations, will continue to broadcast Braves baseball throughout the Southeast all season long.Fans can also listen to live games on the 680 The Fan App!Learn more about the Braves Radio Network here.
